text:
avery: Heads-up — noticed a customer using Dedicated commits in europe-west1 but our promo credits kept applying to the global PAYG project instead. invoice shows credits consumed in us-central1 project tag. anyone else seeing region-tag misrouting?

jay: ugh, sounds like the resource tagging change from the provisioning agent last week. we switched default billing_project to 'redwood-payg' when VPC tags are missing. could be that.

rita: @jay that aligns with the provisioning logs i saw for that customer — their dedicated pool was created before they set the region override, so it landed in the old project. quick check: can you paste the provisioning event id?

jay: provisioning event id: prov-2026-03-12-8943

sam: finance: i pulled the invoice. credit lines: one promo credit batch (promo-2025-q4) applied to project redwood-payg/us-central1, amount 50k. dedicated reserved commit was billed on project redwood-dedup/europe-west1 and showed no promo offset.

avery: Ok — looks like two problems: 1) provisioning default project changed, 2) our billing pipeline doesn't remap credits across projects even when commit-owned capacity exists.

billing-bot: [auto] Detected credit application anomaly: promo-2025-q4 applied outside reserved-commit projects (score: high). Ticket created: BILL-9123.

rita: For a quick mitigation can we run the credit reallocation script against invoice id INV-2026-03-09-8812? I have a dry-run ready.

jay: before we run anything, need to confirm cost center ownership. If we reassign credits retroactively we might break the customer's internal chargeback. sam, finance — ok to propose adjustment?

sam: short answer: yes, if we 1) document the change, 2) notify customer, and 3) post an offset line on next invoice. I'll approve a one-time reallocation for affected invoices under $100k.

avery: Good. Steps then: (1) infra to list affected resources from prov-2026-03-01..2026-03-15 by project_tag, (2) billing to run dry-run of reallocation against INV-2026-03-09-8812, (3) ops to patch provisioning default to honor region override.

jay: running resource dump now. snippet: ```
# prov-2026-03-01..15 filter
prov-2026-03-08-4821  resource:dedicated-pool-34  project:redwood-payg  region:europe-west1  owner:acct-773
prov-2026-03-10-1120  resource:dedicated-pool-41  project:redwood-dedup  region:europe-west1  owner:acct-773
```

rita: That first line is the culprit — pooled into redwood-payg despite region=europe-west1. I see the missing region_override flag in the event metadata.

sam: finance note — when you run the dry-run include audit_comment: "promo reallocate — prov-tag mismatch" so we have trail. Also collect affected invoice numbers.

billing-bot: [auto] Dry-run for INV-2026-03-09-8812 completed: potential reallocation credit: 49,800 USD. No downstream dependency conflicts detected.

avery: Nice. @sam — please approve the reallocation action for that invoice id so we can patch and reconcile. Also we should check expiry windows: promo-2025-q4 credits expire 2026-06-30, so must apply before then.

sam: Approved for INV-2026-03-09-8812. Add cust notification template.

rita: I'll open PR to change the provisioning default and add a validation that fails pool creation if region tag != billing project tag unless explicit override provided. PR will reference prov-2026-03-12-8943 and BILL-9123.

jay: patching now to respect region_override. I'll also backfill a small script to relabel affected resources to the correct billing project so future invoices pick up credits correctly.

avery: Great. After reallocation and backfill, finance — can you confirm invoice adjustments and notify the customer with one combined statement? I'll draft the message.

sam: yep. Once billing-bot posts the reallocation entry and we confirm the backfill, i'll send the customer note.

billing-bot: [auto] Reallocation entry posted for INV-2026-03-09-8812: CREDIT-REALLOC-200123. Audit link: https://billing.redwood.internal/audit/CREDIT-REALLOC-200123

rita: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/provisioning/pulls/451 — patch + validation tests included.

jay: backfill script ran against prov ids [prov-2026-03-08-4821]. Exit: 0. Commands: ```
python tools/billing_backfill.py --ids prov-2026-03-08-4821 --target-project redwood-dedup
```

sam: confirmed adjustment processed. Reallocation credit applied to the reserved commit account, invoice revised and customer notified. Closing BILL-9123 after postmortem.

avery: follow-up action items: 1) infra add unit test for region->project mapping, 2) billing add detection rule to surface credit application crossing projects, 3) ops add playbook for customer notifications. I'll capture these in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
